headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 30, 2026**
article:
The White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the offense. Erick Fedde earned the win for the White Sox, while Tyler Schweitzer secured the save. In other news, the Rangers took down the Guardians 4-2, with Jacob deGrom earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. DeGrom struck out 9 batters and allowed 2 earned runs, while Joc Pederson led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Miami Marlins right-handed pitcher Anthony Bender, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shin stress reaction. Other players on the injured list include Jeremy Peña of the Houston Astros, Dane Myers of the Cincinnati Reds, Keegan Akin of the Baltimore Orioles, Rob Refsnyder of the Seattle Mariners, Matt Shaw of the Chicago Cubs, Ethan Roberts of the Chicago Cubs, and Jacob Wilson of the Athletics.

The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Hayden Juenger from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Owen Carapellotti. The Chicago Cubs traded left-handed pitcher David Peterson to the New York Mets for third baseman Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Orioles 9-3**

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Guardians in 4-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 4-2 win over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jacob deGrom earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. DeGrom struck out 9 batters and allowed 2 earned runs, while Joc Pederson led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Suffer Shutout Loss to Phillies**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates fell to the Philadelphia Phillies 8-0, marking their latest defeat. Trea Turner led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance that included a 3-RBI effort.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a convincing 9-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Riley Greene leading the offense. Greene's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Bender Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right-handed pitcher Anthony Bender has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shin stress reaction.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. Kennedy joins the Mariners in a move that shakes up the team's lineup.
